description: Arrest counts reported to FBI CDE for the nation, a state, or an agency, summed over a month window from January 1985 through the current year. Returns arrests by offense name, offense category, and detailed offense breakdown, by arrestee sex and race, and by age group for male and female arrestees, with every category CDE reports, zeros included. Each grouping is tallied separately and their sums can differ (arrestee sex and race often total less than the offense groupings), so no grouping stands in for another's total. Narrow to one offense with offense. National scope omits identifiers; state requires only state_abbr; agency requires only ori (look it up with fbi_search_agencies). CDE returns zeros both when nothing was reported and when it does not recognize a state or ORI.

from_year.description: Start year of the data range (inclusive), 1985 through the current year. The API uses monthly granularity.

offense.description: CDE arrest offense code to narrow the counts to, or all (default). Codes: 11 Murder and Nonnegligent Homicide; 12 Manslaughter by Negligence; 20 Rape - Not Specified (Legacy); 30 Robbery; 50 Assault - Not Specified; 55 Simple Assault; 60 Burglary; 70 Larceny - Theft; 90 Motor Vehicle Theft; 101 Commercial Sex Acts; 102 Involuntary Servitude; 110 Arson; 140 Prostitution and Commercialized Vice; 141 Prostitution and Commercialized Vice - Prostitution; 142 Prostitution and Commercialized Vice - Assisting or Promoting Prostitution; 143 Prostitution and Commercialized Vice - Purchasing Prostitution; 150 Drug Abuse Violations; 151 Drug Sale/Manufacturing (Unspecified); 152 Drug Sale/Manufacturing - Opium or Cocaine or Their Derivatives; 153 Drug Sale/Manufacturing - Marijuana; 154 Drug Sale/Manufacturing - Synthetic Narcotics; 155 Drug Sale/Manufacturing - Other - Dangerous Nonnarcotic Drugs; 156 Drug Possession (Unspecified); 157 Drug Possession - Opium or Cocaine or Their Derivatives; 158 Drug Possession - Marijuana; 159 Drug Possession - Synthetic Narcotics; 160 Drug Possession - Other - Dangerous Nonnarcotic Drugs; 170 Gambling (Unspecified); 171 Gambling - Bookmaking (Horse and Sport Book); 172 Gambling - Numbers and Lottery; 173 Gambling - All Other Gambling; 180 Forgery and Counterfeiting; 190 Fraud; 200 Embezzlement; 210 Stolen Property: Buying, Receiving, Possessing; 220 Vandalism; 230 Weapons: Carrying, Possessing, Etc.; 240 Sex Offenses (Except Rape, and Prostitution and Commercialized Vice); 250 Offenses Against the Family and Children; 260 Driving Under the Influence; 270 Liquor Law Violations; 280 Drunkenness; 290 Disorderly Conduct; 300 Vagrancy; 310 All Other Offenses (Except Traffic); 330 Curfew and Loitering Law Violations.

ori.description: Nine ASCII-letter/digit ORI code (e.g. CA0010400, DCMPD0000); case-insensitive. Find an agency's ORI with fbi_search_agencies. Only permitted and required for agency scope.

scope.description: Geographic scope: national (omit identifiers), state (only state_abbr), or agency (only ori).

state_abbr.description: Two ASCII-letter state abbreviation (e.g. CA, DC, PR); case-insensitive. Only permitted and required for state scope.

to_year.description: End year of the data range (inclusive), 1985 through the current year.

name: fbi_get_arrests

data_last_updated.description: Date CDE last refreshed arrest data; absent when CDE omits it.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `scope_param_missing`: scope is "state" but state_abbr is missing, or scope is "agency" but ori is missing. `scope_param_incompatible`: Identifiers are supplied for a scope that does not apply them. `year_out_of_range`: from_year or to_year is after the current UTC year. `invalid_date_range`: The complete starting year/month is later than the ending year/month. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

female_arrests_by_age.description: Arrests of female arrestees by age group.

from.description: First month of the summed window (MM-YYYY).

male_arrests_by_age.description: Arrests of male arrestees by age group.

max_data_date.description: Latest data month CDE reports (MM/YYYY); absent when CDE omits it.

notice.description: Present when every count is zero; says whether zeros can also mean an unrecognized state or ORI.

offense.description: Arrest offense code applied, or all.

offense_label.description: CDE label for the applied offense code; "All offenses" for all.

ori.description: Uppercased ORI code; present only for agency scope.

state_abbr.description: Uppercased state abbreviation; present only for state scope.

to.description: Last month of the summed window (MM-YYYY).

title: FBI Get Arrests
